objective: Find and exactly rank complete-admissible affine two-planes within the frozen 37-orbit K1/F2^19 pool before a separately approved SAT experiment.
scope: Public synthetic point-decomposition mathematics only. No private/imported/unknown target or scalar recovery. No solver launch, IC or rho timing in this experiment.

curve.generator: pool_representatives[0]; verify nonzero, on curve and [262543]G=O; trial-division verify prime order

candidate_recipe: Expand each of 37 supplied points by 19 repeated coordinate squarings and both signs (x,x+y). Verify every point on curve, in prime subgroup, 38 distinct signed points per orbit, 703 distinct x values overall and 1406 points.

Enumerate every unordered cross-orbit pair of x values: 666*19^2=240426 pairs. Bucket by bitwise XOR. For every pair of distinct pair records with equal XOR, retain iff their four orbit indices are distinct. The four distinct x values then form an affine two-plane.

Canonical plane key is the lexicographically least sorted 4-x tuple across all 19 simultaneous Frobenius shifts. Deduplicate all pair partitions and simultaneous shifts. Save ALL plane keys with sorted four orbit IDs; no sampled or top-only omission.

For each distinct four-orbit subset with any plane, the whole factor base is its 152 signed points. Choose the lexicographically smallest canonical plane as its encoding witness. Serialize (a,b,c)=(v0,v0 XOR v1,v0 XOR v2) for the sorted key; verify {a,a^b,a^c,a^b^c}=key and b,c nonzero and distinct.

Canonical ranking: decreasing exact-three nonzero target-orbit coverage, then decreasing at-most-three coverage, then increasing sorted four-orbit IDs, then increasing plane key. Select one winner and retain the complete ranked list. No target-runtime based selection.
coverage_algorithm: Canonical target key is minimum polynomial-coordinate x among its 19 Frobenius conjugates; signs share x. Infinity has no nonzero target key.

Use the 6909 public scalar representatives in pool.json with verified G=pool[0] to construct public target points. Assert 6909 distinct canonical keys, each signed orbit of size38, all subgroup members; together 6909*38=262542 covers every nonidentity group point. Store sorted canonical keys, not a discrete-log map for base points.

Build coordinate-only support for all 9139 multisets i<=j<=k of 37 orbits. Fix the representative point of the least-index orbit; vary both other signed full orbits (38*38). Collect nonzero canonical sum keys. Fixing one point is exact by common signed-Frobenius symmetry, including repeated orbit indices. Save bitsets against the sorted target keys, exact dimensions, serialization and per-cache hashes.

Build analogous supports for all 703 unordered orbit-pair multisets by fixing the first representative and varying the second full signed orbit. Singleton support is each base orbit itself. At-most-three union includes singleton, pair and exact-three sets; exact-three permits repeated points and cancellation.

Score each of all C(37,4)=66045 four-orbit subsets by union of its 20 triple multiset supports, 10 pair multiset supports and 4 singleton supports. This gives the full same-cardinality frontier control, including plane-compatible subsets. Retain all scores and coverage histogram; no unconstrained reranking on a runtime.

Required regression: old chosen indices [6,9,22,28] have exact-three6224 and at-most-three6257 out of6909; global maximum exact-three must reproduce6224. Any discrepancy invalidates implementation and stops final interpretation.

Independently replay selected plane winner (if any), prior winner and lexicographically first non-plane four-orbit subset (if one exists) using a direct coordinate MITM pair-sum set, then Q-P lookup for every6909 public target representatives; do not reuse triple support caches in replay. Save per-target verdicts for all three bases, deduplicating identical bases. Group-replay every returned witness; exact-three and at-most-three tested separately.

controls.independent_field: Compare optimized shift/reduce multiplication against independent unreduced carryless product followed by long polynomial division on 4096 SHA256-ranked field pairs from labels N19-AFFINE-v1-field-0..4095; also all361 monomial pairs, all19 squares, all nonzero basis-vector inverses, and4096 inversion identities for nonzero first operands. Verify irreducibility by Frobenius/gcd.
controls.independent_group: A separately written implementation compares doubling, addition, negation, cancellation, identity, on-curve/subgroup tests on all37 representatives and at least4096 deterministic valid point pairs. Repeated points and opposite signs included. N7 compatibility controls may be reused only as separately labeled old evidence, never invented new launches.
controls.plane_enumeration: Independent algorithm fixes each x in orbit0 of a four-orbit selection via common Frobenius only where appropriate; simpler alternative triple-XOR membership over all C(703,3)=57657951 triples with orbit-distinct filter, using O(1) fourth-x lookup and canonicalization, must reproduce plane keys. For performance allow independent pair-bucket enumeration with distinct data structures PLUS exhaustive triple enumeration for the first eight pool orbits. Both counts and key sets checked.
controls.null_geometry: XOR rank-deficient tuples with repeated vertices, repeated orbit IDs, and a one-bit-perturbed nonplane must be rejected. Changing coordinate basis by fixed invertible map (19-bit reversal) must preserve XOR-plane enumeration after mapping back; labels and curve arithmetic stay in original basis.
controls.forgery: Independent checker must reject a winner certificate with one vertex flipped, a wrong orbit ID, an incremented coverage score and a corrupted bitset. Use temporary copies only.
controls.coverage: Prior6224/6257 exact regression plus independent MITM per-target replay for selected/prior/null bases. Full frontier scores from one validated optimized kernel are scoped as computed finite enumeration, independently inspect cache construction and sampled direct controls; no global mathematical closure.
controls.sampling: 4096 field pairs and4096 group pairs exactly. Field labels N19-AFFINE-v1-field-k, k0..4095: first two 32-bit little-endian SHA256 limbs reduced modulo2^19. Group label N19-AFFINE-v1-group-k: first two limbs modulo37, next two modulo38; choose full signed orbit points in ascending(x,y) order. No reselection.

prediction.geometry: At least one complete-admissible plane exists in the fixed37-orbit pool.
prediction.coverage: Maximum plane-compatible exact-three coverage is at least5913/6909, i.e. at least95% of6224. This is a proposal-level empirical prediction, not a distribution theorem.
prediction.sat: No SAT-speed prediction is tested here; a retained plane is only a candidate for the subsequent strong-control SAT contract.

success_criterion: All correctness/forgery/cost controls valid, exhaustive search completed, at least one plane and selected exact-three>=5913. Other valid outputs are finite observations, not broad rejection. No status promotion from Executor.

stop_rules.fixed_runs: Exactly one native correctness/control run and one scientific geometry/cache/frontier run, plus one independent checker run. Compile and non-scientific schema/static checks recorded separately. No target timing sample or solver invocation. Root sole scientific launch owner; Executor implements, tests native controls once only after source readiness; scientific launch requires committed admission. Failed attempts preserved; no automatic retry.
stop_rules.campaign_budget: No CPU or wall campaign cap; watchdog only process protection. Watchdog/oom/implementation failure yields partial checkpoint, not hypothesis rejection. Any correction is additive with explicit provenance.

cost_model: All input reading, field preparation, pool expansion, rectangle discovery, support caches, ranking and validation costs recorded as discovery/preprocessing. Search is per-curve advice and never free cold-start evidence. No comparison to rho or fullIC. Later fixed-description PDP construction timing is a separate quantity.
claim_limits: Finite frozen pool only; no global optimality over all factor bases.
Equal152point bases have4effectiveFrobenius orbit columns; compare both counts.
More coverage or compact membership does not prove propagation or solver improvement.
No claim of novelty; previous affine/Frobenius methods exist.
No new private or unknown target inputs; no base logarithm table.

stages.A: Implement exact protocol; freeze source, compiler and binary; execute single native correctness control with receipt. Root verifies readiness and commits science admission.
stages.B: Root launches one fixed scientific run and one independent checker run, serially; preserve outputs and all telemetry. Executor packages without interpretation.
stages.C: Root snapshots; separately admitted independent source and permanently blind geometry/selected-coverage reviews; Coordinator dispositions.
